import networkx as nx
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit.circuit.library import ZZFeatureMap
from qiskit.primitives import Sampler
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit.circuit.library import TwoLocal
from qiskit import Aer
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram
import functools
import numpy as np

def create_graph_from_edges(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
    return G

def create_qubo_from_graph(G):
    qubo = QuadraticProgram("MaxCut")
    vertices = list(G.nodes())
    edges = G.edges()

    for i, j in edges:
        qubo.add_variable(vertices[i], vtype="BINARY")
        qubo.add_variable(vertices[j], vtype="BINARY")
        qubo.add_interaction(vertices[i], vertices[j], weight=G[i][j]["weight"])
        qubo.add_interaction(vertices[j], vertices[i], weight=G[i][j]["weight"])

    return qubo

def create_qaoa_circuit(qubo, q_bits, p):
    feature_map = ZZFeatureMap(q_bits, reps=1)
    ansatz = TwoLocal(q_bits, ["ry", "rz"], "cx", reps=p, entanglement="circular")

    qaoa = QAOA(feature_map, ansatz, optimizer=COBYLA(), p=p)
    qaoa.qubit_op = qubo.to_ising()
    return qaoa

def solve_max_cut_problem(G, p, shots=1024):
    qubo = create_qubo_from_graph(G)
    qaoa = create_qaoa_circuit(qubo, list(G.nodes()), p)

    sampler = AerSimulator()
    pm = PassManager()

    # Add transpilation passes
    pm.append(PassManager.global_optimization(1))
    pm.append(PassManager.translation(backend=sampler, initial_layout=nx.to_dict_of_lists(G)))

    # Apply the transpilation
    transpiled_circuit = pm.run(qaoa.circuit)

    # Execute the transpiled circuit
    sampler_result = sampler.run(transpiled_circuit, shots=shots).result()
    counts = sampler_result.get_counts()
    max_cut_value = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    max_cut_value_prob = counts[max_cut_value] / shots

    # Calculate approximation ratio
    approximation_ratio = max_cut_value_prob / G.graph["cut_value"]

    return {
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "success_probability": max_cut_value_prob,
        "circuit_depth": transpiled_circuit.depth(),
        "two_qubit_gate_count": transpiled_circuit.count_ops().get("cx", 0),
        "shots": shots,
        "optimizer_calls": qaoa.optimizer.max_iterations,
        "cut_value": G.graph["cut_value"]
    }

def main():
    graph_vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    graph_edges = [
        [0, 1, 3],
        [1, 2, 3],
        [0, 2, 3],
        [3, 4, 4],
        [4, 5, 4],
        [3, 5, 4],
        [0, 6, 10],
        [3, 6, 9]
    ]

    G = create_graph_from_edges(graph_vertices, graph_edges)

    # Set the cut value for the graph
    G.graph["cut_value"] = sum(G[i][j]["weight"] for i, j in G.edges())

    p = 4  # Number of layers

    result = solve_max_cut_problem(G, p)

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
